text: Which holography result, if any, a generic hyperbolic graph fails and {3,4,3,4} passes?
description:
OP-06: a control that separates {3,4,3,4} from generic hyperbolic growth.

Known: the Ryu-Takayanagi experiments measure geodesics against boundary arcs, true of any hyperbolic graph.

Unknown: a property specific to this honeycomb.

Why it matters: without it the holography set is regraded to L1.

Scope: a small theoretical and computational investigation.

Skills: hyperbolic geometry, holography.

Where to start: test/experiment/holography/.

The claims it would move: R-HLG-0001.

Evidence named: roadmap item 0014.
